title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: an email template locale added in a `.custom` pair is listed and sent on the base's address; a dependent's added locale stays under its own package (#28802)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XNUzphnasmraGeKrcFVQSpZ)_

Fixes #28802
Fixes #28779

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #28829

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：邮件模板按「名称 + 语言」逐个成员判断基础包地址上该给谁。客户在 `BASE.custom` 里新增的基础包没有的语言（比如 showcase 只发 `en-US`，客户加 `fr-FR`），现在出现在全局列表、基础包列表和执行列表里，发 `fr-FR` 邮件真的用客户的模板；依赖包在基础包模板名下加的语言，只在依赖包自己的地址下可读，按基础包名或不带包名读取不再返回它（404）。
- **为什么改**：#28777 放行这种新增后，配对包加的语言能按名读到却从不进列表，邮件服务读的是执行列表，所以法语收件人收到英文原版；反过来，依赖包的语言却能冒用基础包的地址被按名读出。#28779 实测，席位选了方案 A（成员粒度共存）。
- **风险与回滚**：中低。只改读取侧，写入闸门不变，非成员类型（除 `email_template` 外的所有类型）字节不变。收窄：按基础包名读依赖包新增语言从 200 变 404。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的三处 `[#28802]`（全局列表成员粒度收窄、基础包列表保留配对包新增成员、按名读取的配对包行与注册表兜底守卫）；`protocol-environment-rows.ts` 的 `baseAddressServesMember`；dogfood 测试文件。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 10/10 通过（main 上 4 红）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

An email template is one item per `(name, locale)` (`ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`), and since #28746 a locale the base does not ship is admitted as an addition, from the base's `.custom` pair (no `overrides`) and from a dependent package. The reads of a base's address decided at name grain. They now decide member by member (option A of the #28779 report, the seat's pick; ADR-0146 D2, ruling A on #28390):

| on the base's address | base's own member | pair's declared override | pair's own added member | dependent's added member |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| by-name read naming the base / naming no package | served | served (as the base's) | served, `_packageId: PAIR` (unchanged) | **404** (was the dependent's body) |
| env-wide list, list scoped to the base, `getMetaItemsForExecution` | listed | listed | **listed** (was absent) | absent (unchanged) |
| `renderTemplate` / `sendTemplate` in that locale | renders it | renders it | **renders it** (was the base's `en-US`) | the base's canonical member (unchanged) |

The dependent's member is still served by the read naming the dependent and by the list scoped to it; the list scoped to the pair is unchanged.

**`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-environment-rows.ts`.** `baseAddressServesMember(base, bound, baseShipsMember)`: the one member-grain answer. A member bound to the base or to no package is served; a member bound to the base's pair is served when the base does not ship that member; anything else (a dependent's member, a pair's undeclared row at a member the base ships, which the write gate refuses) is not.

**`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`**, bundle types only (read from `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`, never a literal; `email_template` is its only entry):

- **Env-wide list** (`readFlattenedMetaItems`, the narrowing to the sole shipper): an item another package binds under a name one code package ships is kept when `baseServesBundleMember` says so. For every other type the expression is byte-identical (`isBundle && …` is false).
- **List scoped to the base**: the pair's row at a member the base does not ship, which the merge held back as an unseated stand-in, is kept (`unseated.delete`). Only for a name the base ships.
- **By-name read** (`readMetaItem`): when no served-row candidate holds a row and the base ships the name but not the member, the pair's own row at that member is read (`findServedOverlayRow` naming the pair) and served under its binding. The registry's last tier (the first composite match across packages, ADR-0048 §3.3) is then guarded: an answer the base's address does not serve is dropped (`registryMemberServedAt`); for a read naming no member, the base's own canonical-first member is asked instead.
- Three private helpers (`shipsBundleName`, `baseServesBundleMember`, `pairOfAddedMember`) count shipped members through the existing member-aware `shippedArtifactsOf`.

**Why the pair's row and not the registry.** Measured: with the pair's and a dependent's `fr-FR` both stored, the registry holds one entry for that member (the last hydration wins), so the base's address served the dependent's body even with the pair present (red case in both test files below). The stored row is the pair's own, wherever the registry slot stands.

**PR #28800's shape pin flipped.** `email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read.dogfood.test.ts` now pins the behaviour: its SHAPE cases are renamed and assert the 404, and a second describe (its own boot) pins the pair-added locale and the pair-plus-dependent case.

## Tests

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/email-template-dependent-unshipped-locale-read.dogfood.test.ts`: 10 cases over the real showcase and its HTTP doors. RED on main `c064d3a2` (4 failed / 6 passed): the base-named and package-less reads served the dependent's `fr-FR` (2 cases), the base's lists and executing list left the pair's `fr-FR` out and `renderTemplate fr-FR` rendered `en-US`, and with both stored the base's address served the dependent's. GREEN at `f085057c`: 10/10 (os-verify-lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-bundle-member-base-address.test.ts` (new): the real protocol over the real engine and an in-memory driver; 5 cases: pair addition on every read; dependent addition 404 on the base's address; pair and dependent at one locale; a bundle with no canonical member read with no member (the base's member, not a dependent's `en-US`); the pair's declared `en-US` override beside its added `fr-FR`. RED on the base's `metadata-protocol` src (5/5 failed); GREEN 5/5 at `f085057c`.
- Package suites at `f085057c`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` typecheck + test (296 files passed, 4 skipped; 22068 tests passed), `@objectstack/objectql` typecheck + test (520 files, 9988 tests passed).
- Ablations, one per changed behaviour, each leg mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, restore to the HEAD blob verified), `metadata-protocol` rebuilt and the mutation proved absent from `dist/` by `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs --absent`, both files run:
  - A1, drop the member-grain list change (env-wide keep → `isBundle && false`, scoped-list `unseated.delete(it)` → `void it`): unit 3 red (the three pair-addition cases), dogfood 2 red (the pair's lists and send; pair beside dependent). Dependent-only cases stay green.
  - A2, drop the by-name registry guard: unit 2 red (dependent 404; no-member read), dogfood 2 red (the two dependent-on-base cases). Pair cases stay green.
  - A3, drop the pair's stored-row read: unit 1 red and dogfood 1 red, both the pair-beside-dependent case only.
  - The first A1 attempt did not run: `if (false)` replacements failed the DTS build (unused locals), so nothing was measured; re-run with type-neutral replacements as above. A restore build followed the last leg.

## Acceptance notes

- **`Metadata-protocol: semantic`, not the claim's expected `narrowed`.** What an author can write is unchanged (no key, value or write refused; the #28746 gate is untouched); what a written dependent locale and a written pair locale MEAN on the base's address changed. AGENTS.md: "a changed meaning or default is `semantic`". Both take `minor`.
- **Stamp of the pair's added member on the base's address is the pair's id**, on the lists as on the by-name read (which already stamped it so). A declared override keeps being stamped as the base's.
- **Draft preview** (`previewDrafts`) of a pair-added member on the base's address is not covered: the preview arm asks the served-row candidates only, so it falls through to the active read, which now serves the pair's published row. Dormant; noted, not filed.
- **A package-unbound row at the same unshipped member** is served first by the by-name read (its candidate precedes), while the scoped list's held stand-in is the unbound row there. Pre-existing ordering, not changed here.
- The layered view (`/layers?package=BASE&member=fr-FR`) still answers 404, as noted on PR #28800.
- **Overlap re-read** before `pr_create`: open PRs touching `packages/metadata-protocol/src/` or `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` are #28811, #28808, #28731, #28791. `git merge-tree` against this head: no conflict with any; none of their diffs touches the narrowing, the scoped list's stand-ins, `findServedOverlayRow`, `registry.getItem` or `ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`.

## Verification

Gate sweep at `f085057c`: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 66 families; 66 run, all exit 0 (`dispatch-gates --ran` reads "66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED", a derived zero). One first ran exit 3 on a prerequisite and was re-run green: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (seven packages outside the dogfood closure were unbuilt). The record is `pm-orders/server/28802-gates-ran.txt` in the project files.

Full dogfood battery (the `(narrowing)` arm) at `f085057c`, under the lock as CI runs it (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, no shard, no path): VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 380 passed, 3 skipped (383); Tests 3118 passed, 28 skipped (3146).

Changeset `.changeset/28802-bundle-member-base-address.md`: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` minor, both declaration lines, the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition. CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.
